Titles.jpn: ディズニー ツイステッドワンダーランド ザ アニメーション

Summaries.eng: Once upon a time, the Great Seven had ruled over their own lands in Twisted-Wonderland, a world of magic and wonder. Their illustrious deeds were so legendary that the prestigious magic school Night Raven College, modeled its seven dorms after them: Queen of Hearts, the King of Beasts, the Sea Witch, the Sorcerer of the Sands, the Fairest Queen, the King of the Underworld, and the Thorn Fairy. However, high school student Yuken (Yu) never knew this world existed until he is suddenly transported into the middle of Night Raven College's entrance ceremony. Now, he must face monsters, whimsical magicians-in-training, and mysterious incidents, all without any magic of his own. Will Yu ever find a way back to his own world?
Summaries.jpn: 物語は、魔法の鏡を介して、別の世界への主人公の呼び出しから始まります。 そこで、主人公は魔法のアカデミー「ナイトレイヴンズカレッジ」を発見し、彼の保護を提供する仮面の男である後者の謎のディレクターに会います。 彼の世界に戻る方法を探して、プレーヤーは学校の他の学生を知ることから始めなければなりません...

Aliases: ディズニー ツイステッドワンダーランド

Titles.jpn: エピソード オブ ハーツラビュル

Summaries.eng: Yuken Enma, a high school student who is magically transported to Night Raven College, a magic academy for aspiring mages inspired by Disney villains. Since he has no magical abilities of his own, Yu must navigate this strange new world with the help of his new, mischievous classmates, Ace and Deuce, while trying to find a way back home. A central plot point in season 1 is the conflict with Riddle Rosehearts, the strict dorm leader of Heartslabyul who is obsessed with rules.

Suddenly whisked to the magical world of Twisted-Wonderland, high schooler Yu wonders why he was even summoned. He has no magical abilities and is not even from this world. All he wants is to go back home, but he comes face-to-face with a fire-breathing monster instead.
Summaries.jpn: 高校生のユウは、異世界「テッドワンダーランド」に召喚される。困惑する中、モンスターのグリムが乱入する。

Summaries.eng: Yu is given special permission to live and work at Night Raven College while he searches for a way back to his own world. Things seem to be going well for Yu as he settles into his new environment, until a familiar monster reappears with its fiery temper.
Summaries.jpn: 雑用係として生活することになったユウは、新入生のエース・トラッポラとデュース・スペードに出会う。

Summaries.eng: To reverse their expulsion, Ace and Deuce head towards the abandoned mine with Yu and Grim to search for a magestone. Just when they thought they were alone in the mine, a terrifying voice echoes from the depths of the darkness.
Summaries.jpn: 退学を免れるため魔法石を探すことになったエースたち。勝手についてきたグリムも合流し、鉱山へ向かう。

Summaries.eng: Ace barges into Yu and Grim's dorm late at night, wearing a strange collar. Following Yu's suggestion, they head to Heartslabyul House the next day, but a surprising encounter in the renowned rose garden thwarts their plans.
Summaries.jpn: ユウは監督生としてグリムと共にオンボロ寮での生活を始める。その夜、首輪をつけられたエースが訪れてきた。

Summaries.eng: The residents of Heartslabyul House are growing increasingly unhappy with their housewarden's strict rule-abiding ways. Meanwhile, Ace must find a way to convince the housewarden to remove the collar around his neck.
Summaries.jpn: 規則に不満を漏らすエース。そこに現れたリドルに叱責され従うが、許しを得るためマロンタルト作りを決意する。

Summaries.eng: Ace notices Riddle's happy mood as the perfectly prepared unbirthday party begins. Seeing this as his chance to get the awful collar removed, Ace approaches Riddle with the chestnut tart he baked. However, Riddle's unexpected reaction turns the situation from bad to worse.
Summaries.jpn: エースたちは謝罪のタルトを渡すも、リドルは予想に反し激怒。怒りは収まらず、4人は会場を追い出されてしまう。

Summaries.eng: Ace and Deuce's duel with Riddle becomes the catalyst that unleashes all the dissatisfaction of the other Heartslabyul residents. However, the unexpected backlash shocks Riddle so deeply that he begins to undergo an ominous change.
Summaries.jpn: 決闘後のリドルの嘲笑に怒ったエース。それに続き寮生の不満が爆発。動揺したリドルに異変が起こり始める。

Summaries.eng: Riddle's magic and emotions begin to rampage, leaving the Heartslabyul students frozen in fear of his immense power. As Headmage Crowley realizes the danger of the situation, he orders the entire school to evacuate. However, Ace, Deuce, Yu, and Grim refuse. Instead of heading to safety, they are determined to face Riddle and his raging magic despite knowing they are no match for him.
Summaries.jpn: 感情の限界を超えたリドルが暴走してしまう。ユウたちは逃げずに立ち向かい、仲間と共に彼を止めようとする。
